sn22.153:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati?
sn22.153:1.3: “no cassaṃ no ca me siyā, na bhavissāmi, na me bhavissatī”ti.
sn22.153:1.5: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati:
sn22.153:1.6: “no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatī”ti.
sn22.153:1.10: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn22.153:1.11: “no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissāmi, na me bhavissatī”ti.
sn22.153:1.15: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?

sn22.153:1.18: “no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissāmi, na me bhavissatī”ti?
